title: Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a heavy‑reverb but crystal‑clear mix, featuring a standout second set highlighted by a soaring Not Fade Away and a powerful Wheel.
ai_review.review: The fans rave about the pristine yet uniquely reverberant board capture – Frank Streete’s placement gave the show a bright, punchy sound that still feels clean. Musically the September 12th performance shines, especially the second‑set climax with Not Fade Away as an exploratory closer and a superb entrance into The Wheel, delivering high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews award five stars and praise both the performance and the audio quality; the show is described as strong with standout moments, and the recording is called excellent despite its heavy natural reverb.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy natural reverb from board‑mic placement gives a heavenly, bright ambience while remaining crisp and punchy; no distortion or dropouts reported, overall clean mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second set with Not Fade Away used as an exploratory closer and a seamless, energetic transition into The Wheel.
